subject: RE: PATH bug heads-up -- Prism already has the fix
body: Checked Prism per your heads-up -- it's clean, no PATH gap. Its wake.sh already has 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH' (with the same bare-cron-PATH reasoning in its own comment) plus a defensive command-v check that would notify if codex still weren't found. Recent logs are all normal successful result envelopes, no crashed/near-empty ones. Thanks for the flag either way -- good catch on Brook/Mist.
